handoff.objective: Isolated root content-at-commit custody for director, technical_approval
constraints: PROSPECTIVE: every canonical destination below is proposed until root materializes, commits and pushes exact bytes. Root alone canonical/Git/lane/claims/network/storage/credentials. Worker writes only assigned fresh outside scratch; no fetch/merge/PR action.
Policy and effort are requested only; actual serving model remains unverified unless actual adapter evidence establishes it. No retrospective timestamps, model attestations or read lists.

No changes to old experiment/source/raw/review records; preserve invalid_output/check_returncode1/publishedfalse and all full-cost/native-counter/RSS/clock qualifications. No novelty, exponent, family, advantage or closure claim.

No candidate feedback from diagnostic orbit/log/labels/tables; no fitting, base/arm selection, replacement reference bank, new curves/targets/nonces or fresh-population run. Study diagnostic work and retained regression work are fully paid and separately exposed.

All zero/undefined/capped/failed/partial/refusal rows retained. A timeout or incomplete enumeration is missing data, never q=0. Stop on correctness or input/source mismatch; retain smallest witness and original requirement in linked problem record.

Root alone Git; stage only actual declaredartifacts; absentconditionalartifacts explicitly excludedwithreason. Archive scope never expandsimplicitly. Verify parent/reachablecommit/exactpaths/sha256/recordIDs before completion.
completion_gate: Actual snapshotcommit plus separate actualreceipt commit; root verifies rawGit against exactmanifest before downstreamuse. No futurecommit/receipt placeholders.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Isolated root content-at-commit custody for director, technical_approval
